ACI 301, Section 1.6.3: Requires that testing laboratories shall be qualified and available prior to commencement of concrete works. Contractor shall have following below mentioned corrective action. Contractor shall immediately mobilize and establish the site laboratory, ensuring all necessary equipment, calibration certificates, and qualified laboratory technicians are available.
